testResults.name: ui-production-build
testResults.result: exit=0 with adapter-static prerender of build/demo/backtest.html and build/demo/dag.html; repeated clean across all iterations including commit 92d7f2c

testResults.name: report-card-composition
testResults.result: BacktestReport renders as a collapsible chat card: headline stat strip plus PnL preview with fill markers collapsed; tabbed body expanded with PnL & orders (equity curve plus fills table), Securities per-instrument candles, Risk analysis (risk tiles, equity and drawdown charts, PnL histogram), model-provided panel groups, and Statistics last

testResults.name: stats-table-and-fixture
testResults.result: StatsTable renders the backend metrics dict as grouped tables with percent/ratio/money/ms/duration/bool formatting and an Other group for unknown keys; fixture carries the full T207-shaped stats dict and a model-provided benchmark panel

testResults.name: theme-and-render-qa
testResults.result: Navy opaque surface ladder (bg #0a0f1a, card #151d30 with shadow, wells #0c1220); headless-Edge render of /demo/backtest pixel-sampled chart cards: header and chart body identical rgb(12,18,32); risk-tab y-scaling includes visible extremes (flex-shrink fix); canvases paint opaque well backgrounds; charts share one time camera with per-chart value zoom

limitations: Live data arrives through the T207 artifact-view payload; the demo renders from the deterministic fixture
